worldcombat.skill.liquidation.summary: Compress water into a close-fitting narrow blade, take half a step forward, then sweep it from one side to the other: everything it touches is cut, shoved and left soaked, with a chance to crack its Defence down. While the user stands in rain, the water presses harder.
worldcombat.skill.liquidation.use.0: A short step then a horizontal cut across the row in front
worldcombat.skill.liquidation.use.2: Leave the target soaked for later water moves
worldcombat.skill.liquidation.descriptio: The blade cut deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s block blade thickness; the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.

Take a %1$s block step along your aim, then sweep a %2$s block radius fan of %3$s degrees from that spot; a row standing to the side is caught in the same pass, while a far foe dead ahead is never closed on.

The full sweep takes about %1$s; each target touched is shoved about %2$s blocks outward along the blade. Judgement and visuals read the same origin, direction and radius, and walls block each segment. You can also pick a direction and sweep empty space.

A touched target has a %1$s chance to have its armour cracked, lowering Defence by %2$s stage(s) and leaving a sundered mark; if it is not already wet it is left soaked for %3$s for later water moves.
worldcombat.skill.liquidation.shred.on: Sundering form: a higher crack chance, two stages at once and longer soak, but less cut power and a longer preparation and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.liquidation.shred.off: Crushing form: more cut power and one stage of Defence drop, and it comes out sooner.
worldcombat.skill.liquidation.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.liquidation.growth.0: At level %1$s, the cut power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.liquidation.growth.1: At level %1$s, the cut power rises to %2$s and the crack chance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.liquidation.preference: On: a higher crack chance, two stages at once and a longer soak, but less cut power and a longer preparation and cooldown. Off: the crushing form, more cut power and one stage of Defence drop.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of using Liquidation. Larger values chase harder; this is a short horizontal cut, so a distant chase often arrives after the row has scattered.
On: prefer targets whose armour is not yet sundered (so the hit lands the crack). Off: order by threat and distance only.
On: aim at the direction with the most enemies in front, so one sweep catches more of them. Off: order by threat and distance only.
